dogecoin.text: I did open a Robinhood account just for #Dogecoin. I only have 9 bucks worth of it.
I read that #Dogecoin started off as a joke. Now it's rising. I'm only talking about it because I have some.

If Dogecoin reaches the same price as LTC, I would still work. Just less. Maybe the minimum to keep my benefits but with better coverage.

If it the same as ETC or BTC, goodbye.
Oh Dogecoin. Please hit 10 cents this week. I would like more but let's keep it real.
Oh hi. How's the weather up there #dogecoin?
Oh hey 41 cents. Nice to see you again. #Dogecoin $DOGE
May the #dogecoin be with you.

It's official. I can look at @GoZeroG reservations flying out of Long Beach and say, "Yes, I can." June is a bit too soon. But February of next year 🤔. It may not be Dogecoin to the moon but they can simulate the moon's gravity. https://t.co/4CkxuvyzLO
I know I tweeted the news article earlier. But this is from Wario himself. $Doge (literally) to the moon. #dogecoin #dogetothemoon
Downloaded and signed up for @Gemini. Your Dogecoin can earn interest over there.
It's now up to $0.03. I have passive income... Very very small passive income. Also, I just moved all of my $DOGE on Gemini to #GeminiEarn. If I'm gonna hodl, might as well make it work.
I'm happy for the guy, but does the Dogecoin millionaire have other clothes? That hoodie is either the only thing he has or he has a lot of it.
My $DOGE on #GeminiEarn made $0.02 😱. I feel like I should move all of it over to Earn.

I swear some of these Dogecoin millionaires have only heard of Elon Musk recently. Okay, maybe just this girl I'm watching on YouTube. Not everything he does or tweets is a cryptic message about DOGE.
Oh shit. Dogecoin is on Coinbase. Normal peasant Coinbase. Wooo!
Hold on. I'm just curious. Would I have been able to get a ticket using Dogecoin or is that just Dallas home games only?
Oh damn. Dogecoin interest on Gemini is now 7.4% APY.
That 7.4% Dogecoin interest on Gemini is pretty nice.

Mmm. My Robinhood portfolio is almost half stocks. I mean, that's mainly due to the volatility of crypto. In my case, Dogecoin. Whenever the hell they come out with a wallet, I'm transferring it all out.
Don't get too excited when you see Dogecoin or your preferred cryptocurrency trending on Twitter. It's probably under the "For you" tab and not the actual "Trending" or "News" tab.
When I first bought Dogecoin, there were 2 zeros after the decimal. There were 5 zeros when I first bought Shiba Inu. There's 4 now. It's been 4 for a while. Let's keep knocking it down. #SHIB #DOGE

Speaking of Australia and New Zealand, I remember when Dogecoin was skyrocketing. I was looking up roundtrip tickets, hotels, and was like "I can afford this shit NOT on a credit card." But I kept holding. Whatever.

Not seeing crypto "investing" retweets on my feed anymore. Not hating on it. My first Robinhood purchase was Dogecoin. It went up like crazy. Then I decided on stocks. I still hold Doge and Shiba just in case.
